families.label: Shiny Vault · Paldean Fates
families.known: A “holographic, silver, textured foil border” that Japan did not get, with “textured artwork” on the shiny cards. The treatment is documented outside Bulbapedia; the repeat is not. The finish is drawn as relief: these rarities now wear the granular sparkle surface; the documented silver border is still not modelled.
families.needs: A source naming the paper of that silver border and of the textured artwork, plus the area — a border plus textured artwork is not a rectangle this build can cut. The only name collectors offer for the family is “Galaxy holo”, which Bulbapedia and folio.fyi both document as another name for Cosmos.
families.source: Bleeding Cool and PokéBeach, Paldean Fates set guide

families.label: Shiny Vault · Shining Fates
families.known: The Shiny Rare rarity “is used for all cards in the Shiny Vault subset”, and those cards “have a special embossed Holofoil treatment”, promised in product copy as “beautiful etched cards”. No repeat, no area. The finish is drawn as relief: these rarities now wear the granular sparkle surface.
families.needs: A source naming the etched paper and its repeat, plus the foiled area. “Galaxy holo” is refused for the same reason as Hidden Fates — it names Cosmos — and folio.fyi files “textured or etched” as relief rather than a printed pattern, so a repeat has to be demonstrated before either can be drawn.

families.label: Shiny Vault · Hidden Fates
families.known: “All have a special embossed Holofoil treatment.” The finish is documented; the repeat and the foil area are not. The finish is drawn as relief: these rarities now wear the granular sparkle surface, so the card renders embossed while its paper stays unnamed.
families.needs: A source naming the paper behind the embossed treatment — its marks, pitch or density — and stating the foiled area. The search is on record: Bulbapedia calls Cosmos “often referred to as Galaxy Holofoil” and folio.fyi confirms galaxy is another name for cosmos, so the collector label cannot be promoted. A publisher or foil-stock statement, or a macro photograph showing a repeat that is not Cosmos, would reopen it.
